dedupe_keys.name: nyc capital projects dashboard data citywide budget spend and schedule

description: The NYC Capital Projects Dashboard collection covers all major capital infrastructure projects with a committed budget, joining the Office of Management and Budget's financial data with agency schedule data through the Financial Management Service (FMS) ID. The core Citywide Budget and Schedule table held 56,525 rows when read with reporting period, managing and sponsor agency, project and FMS identifiers and names, description, total budget, spend to date, current phase with start and forecast end, forecast completion, actual design, procurement and construction start and end dates, borough, community board, budget line and ten-year plan category. Companion tables give budget and spend by fiscal year and the history and variance of schedules and spending across reporting snapshots; only projects in design or later have schedules. Coverage: New York City capital projects of all agencies, including schools, libraries, parks, public buildings and other infrastructure. Access: free on NYC Open Data (updated July 2026). Licence: NYC Open Data terms. Caveats: FMS IDs and projects are not always one to one, so totals need care. Simulation uses: planned public facility construction and renovation timelines for city infrastructure and investment scenarios. Related records: the NYC DOB permit issuance and the Tacoma capital projects.
